skills.name: Lưỡng Nghi Thủ
skills.design: Quick inexpensive precise palm strike reducing enemy Attack Power. One narrow forward open-palm action, other hand retracts at waist. Compact paired dark/light palm contact mark; weakening feedback is a small broken downward chevron next to contacted target, no stun chains, shield, ranged orb, slow ring or defense-break symbol. Tiny neutral target silhouette only for feedback. Icon: open palm with split light/dark pressure mark and small descending notch; recognizable palm silhouette.

skills.name: Huyền Âm Chưởng
skills.design: Short Yin wave slowing movement AND attack speed. Sinking stance, palm sweeps low forward, a short dark-centered pale-edged broad crescent wave just in front of hands, compact near-body footprint. Show release/wave/contact/dissipation. Slow feedback: two small separated trailing brackets near target feet and a small interrupted cadence arc near target weapon hand; no ice, frost, root, stun, long projectile, extra range or elemental damage. Icon: squat Yin crescent with two trailing cadence bars, distinct from precise palm icon.

skills.name: Dương Khí Kích
skills.design: Short palm attack refunds some mana only on successful hit. Raised rear palm draws inward then compact forward heel-of-palm snap, bright compact diamond-shaped contact with restrained dark counterpart. Separate success-only return of TWO tiny light motes from contact to caster wrist/torso; dashed diagram arrow labels SUCCESS ONLY. On miss no return motes. Not healing, lifesteal, floating mana orb, ranged projectile or protective shield. Icon: bright palm heel/compact spark with small inward hooked return stroke, clearly different from other palms.

skills.name: Thái Cực Thần Công
skills.design: Mana shield absorbs damage by spending mana. Open crossed palms at chest -> balanced circular hand opening -> ready palm stance -> neutral ending. Show separate activation / sustained protective state / absorption flash / ending. Personal thin broken light-dark spherical contour at shoulder-to-feet silhouette, transparent interior, face/limbs fully readable, small contact ripple where incoming hit meets shield; no invulnerability, heal, knockback, projectile reflect, aura affecting allies. Caption 'Lifetime from authoritative state; toggle/timed unresolved'. No countdown. Icon: thin personal shield outline enclosing small yin-yang, distinct from ground formations.

skills.name: Thái Cực Trận
skills.design: ULTIMATE: Yin-Yang ground field periodically damages and slows within its area. Palms gather -> press down/outward -> hold balanced stance -> return. Separate activation / sustained loop / periodic pulse / ending ground studies. Circular elevated-overworld ellipse with twin interlocking light-dark flowing boundary strokes, small yin-yang center seal and sparse inward curved accents; at least 80% open interior with visible stone ground, hero and targets. Pulse remains inside boundary, slow brackets only for targets inside. No sword symbols, imprisonment wall, ally protection, implosion, pulling, terrain cracks or opaque full-field disk. Area placement and size diagrammatic pending authoritative zone; no chosen exact radius/duration/pulse count. Icon: twin flowing ground-ring halves and small central yin-yang, distinct from personal shield and octagonal sword formation.

skills.name: Thất Tinh Kiếm
skills.design: Several strong CLOSE-RANGE sword slashes, no projectiles. Distinct compact sword combo key poses: coiled ready -> rising diagonal cut -> returning crossing cut -> controlled recovery. Show short connected melee blade arcs within arm+sword reach; small seven-star motif only as restrained decorative constellation, NOT exact hit count and not seven orbiting summoned swords. Impact sparks are compact. No dash, teleport, stun, ranged sword-energy release. Icon: two crossing close-range blade arcs with small restrained star arrangement; straight sword readable.

skills.name: Nhân Kiếm Hợp Nhất
skills.design: Piercing NON-HOMING sword-energy projectile. Align straight sword and forearm -> precise forward thrust RELEASE -> short recoil -> recovery; character stays planted, NOT a dash. Lower study explicitly separates release flash, elongated pointed silver/ivory qi lance travelling RIGHT along one straight arrow, compact impact/exit marks at two neutral target silhouettes on same straight line, then dissipate. Piercing continues same heading, no curved tracks, seekers, lock-on, teleport, sword riding or explosion radius. Projectile shape elongated straight double-edged qi spear, distinct from broad multi-wave ultimate. Icon: ONE straight long pointed qi blade crossing two small broken plane marks.

skills.name: Bát Quái Kiếm Trận
skills.design: Sword formation damages enemies within a zone. Sword raised in centered disciplined salute -> tip lowers to formation -> ready stance -> recovery. Separate activation / sustained loop / periodic damage pulse / ending. Ground boundary is a thin OCTAGON in elevated orthographic projection, eight sparse restrained trigram-like corner marks and small inward-pointing spectral sword motifs around edge, clear open center at least80% unfilled and ground/characters visible. No huge sword rain, protection barrier, slow brackets, stun, imprisonment walls, ally buff or outward projectile attacks. Decorative swords do not imply exact damage hit count. No numeric radius, placement or duration decision. Icon: open octagonal boundary with small inward sword points, clearly distinct from round flowing Thai Cuc field.

skills.name: Tọa Sát Bác Đồ
skills.design: SHORT COUNTER STANCE: being attacked prompts retaliatory slash. Four panels MUST be separately labelled READY / ATTACK RECEIVED / TRIGGERED RESPONSE / RECOVERY. Readiness: bent knees, straight sword held diagonally close to torso, tiny incomplete light-dark crescent near hilt; no shield bubble. Attack-received panel permits small contact mark on hero, no blocked-X or zero damage. Triggered response is ONE compact opposite diagonal close-range retaliatory slash. Show separate readiness loop + triggered counter + recovery + untriggered ending neutral stance. No invulnerability, guaranteed block, damage reflection beam, evade/dash/teleport or healing. Icon: low angled guard blade plus small hooked returning slash, no shield.

skills.name: Vạn Kiếm Quy Tông
skills.design: ULTIMATE: several sword-energy waves in a WIDE FRONTAL pattern. Centered sword and two-finger preparation -> controlled sword sweep release -> extended directional follow-through -> recovery, planted feet, no dash. Show separate preparation / staggered directional releases / straight travel / individual impacts / fade. Broad fan-shaped footprint in FRONT ONLY with several spaced pale blade-wave silhouettes and balanced charcoal cores, clear gaps, all headings chosen at release and drawn as straight divergent arrows. No homing curves, radial360 storm, skyward sword rain, rear attacks, target tracking or exact wave count decision. Representative handful of waves is schematic, not authoritative count/range. Icon: three spaced forward-diverging blade-wave silhouettes with clear negative-space gaps, no complete circle.

additionalIcons.name: Võ Đang Quyền
additionalIcons.design: Normal PALM attack: one clean open palm in ivory sleeve with dark cuff, plain short contact notch at fingertips, no yin-yang swirl, no downward weakening chevron, no slow brackets, no return motes, no mana effect. Modest simple melee icon; preserve approved basic animation.

additionalIcons.name: Võ Đang Kiếm
additionalIcons.design: Normal STRAIGHT SWORD attack: approved thin silver straight sword with distinctive small yin-yang silver guard, angled across tile with one short melee slash stroke. A SINGLE tiny secondary straight qi glint behind blade suggests occasional non-homing Kiếm Khí only, not guaranteed firing, not multi-wave ultimate. Distinct from piercing icon: include dark gripping hand and ivory cuff, prominent physical hilt and short blade arc. Preserve approved animation; no production VFX yet.

additionalIcons.name: Thái Cực Tâm Pháp
additionalIcons.design: INNATE PASSIVE icon only: calm centered yin-yang emblem inside a restrained open meditation/inward-flow circular motif, two small resource droplets on opposing inner edge and a small open cadence notch. Balanced mana capacity, regeneration and efficiency theme; do not imply shield/protection, healing, elemental attack or active cast. No character action board, no in-world aura. Make standalone emblem distinct from shield-outline and ground-ring formation icons.
